description: A query in the reconstruction keeps the query policy of engine §4 for a maximal terminator. The competitor c holds two conditions. begins($x, open) holds only where [T] stays optional, and ¬begins($x, probe) holds only where T is maximal, since chunk → A B is longer. Both hold, so c is a second reading. A query under the reconstruction's own routes fails the first, and one without terminal maximality fails the second (engine §7.6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable U
%elidable maximal T
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a pair [U]
%rule b pair [U] [U]
%rule c $x(pair) U
%conditions begins($x, open), ¬begins($x, probe)
%rule pair A B
%rule open A [T] B
%rule probe chunk [T] B
%rule chunk A | A B
